notes.title: V21 - Housekeeping update
notes.content:
V21 - Housekeeping update


 Decreased install size
 Added a new toggle in controls to toggle between On Press or On Release of input
 Updated the Unity backend
 Implemented several translation suggestions
 Proper Cloud saving Cross-Platform Win/Mac/Lin now
 Migrating save files (copying not deleting so old one is still there) from old versions to new save location to be consistent with all my games.
 Removed additional exit menu and videos. 
 Added unified Update text and "More Games By" panel on main menu that will be in all my games going forward. If you click the panel it will open to the games page and then won't suggest that game again on this installation. Also allows me to push update text without a full game update in case of urgent issues. 
 Fixed reported bugs
 Updated store page and features where appropriate
 Resolved the broken Steam Leaderboards button
 Resolved crash on exit on Mac
 Probably other minor fixes I forgot (sorry)

Thanks yall.
adamvision <3

notes.title: Ding Dong XL Version 7 Update
notes.content:
A new challenge awaits you in the brand new game changing Infinite Mode! Improved graphics, better balance, and many more additions and changes. Check out Ding Dong XL V7 now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32763348/a4d869a960a2e0915114ecc60bc25c23a3a4f052.gif

Patch Notes: (additional leader boards + online for switch)
 New Infinite play mode added
 New Unlock-able Space Rocks skin
 Bonus Points power-up is now worth 5 Points
 Added Bit Blaster, Orbt, and Diamo songs for each of the special characters
 When you're stationary with a time slow power-up, the growth of the ball will stop completely
 Early button presses after death will not be erroneously detected
 Power-up timers correctly reset when dying and restarting they now also disappear upon death 
 Pink enemy now correctly has it's trail fade in/out with the rest of the enemy
 Modified and added some little secrets here and there
 Re-balanced some late game elements to ensure there are always viable paths to take and made 250+ not dependent on power-ups
 Player can now remain idle slightly longer before exploding

I hope you enjoy the latest update, and if you do, make sure to leave a Steam review and share the game with your friends. Thanks for the continued support of my games. 

-Adam Nickerson (@nickervision)


Don't forget to also add Super Bit Blaster XL to your Steam Wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/865040/Super_Bit_Blaster_XL/

notes.title: V4
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

-Modified the Blade (power03) power up to now award a point for every enemy that you cut through during it's duration
-Modified the Point (power00) power up to now award three points upon activation instead of two
-Modified the Time (power01) power up to no longer completely stop time. Now the power will slow time to about 25% speed but for a longer duration. This adds more challenge as the enemies still move which decreases the over powered nature of this power up in end game times but also allows players to better get close calls on the slower enemies.
-Slightly altered the overall balancing of enemy spawning and speeds to compensate for the changes made to power ups.
-Changed font throughout to better fit into the games aesthetic
-Improved the look of power up pick ups
-Changed the appearance of text and effects for bonus points
-Better effects and particles for when enemies explode and hit walls
-Softened and altered a variety of particle effects to make them blend better with the overall aesthetics and be more lean for lower end CPUs
-Altered all in game menus to have more noticeable / functional selection methods.
-Added minor new background effects to further the neon / soft / ?foggy? kind of aesthetic I was aiming for
-Pressing back from the round end menu will now back out to the character select screen, and then back again will go to the menu 
-Resolved bug where screen shaking continued into pause menu
-Fixed some rare unusual particle layering during the pause menu

I have also created a separate branch on Steam for players that have issues or don't like the changes made, so they can still access V3 through the BETA menu in the Steam Client.

Thanks for all the great suggestions from the community; special shout out to Hex Decimus.

Thank you to everyone for playing and sharing the game with your friends and family I appreciate your support immensely. If you are enjoying my games, make sure to leave brief Steam Reviews and let others know to check them out, this is incredibly helpful for us small developers to get discovered by more players. :)

Adam Nickerson
Follow Nickervision Studios on Steam

notes.title: V3
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
-Fixed, resolved, and improved a variety of effects and code based on improvements I made for the upcoming Ding Dong VR version.
-Fixed Enemy07 not correctly slowing down during time stop.
-Improved the ++ point power up effect.
-Improved the time stop power up effect to make it easier to know when its running out.
-The points text will now flash briefly every time your points change.
-There is a new slight graphical effect on the edges of the screen that makes gaining a point even more satisfying.
-Modified various explosions to be more efficient and look cooler.
-Resolved a lag spike on first play that was being caused by the save system.
-Resolved some issues with incorrect tutorial icons

Thank you to everyone for playing and sharing the game with your friends and family I appreciate your support immensely. If you are enjoying my games, make sure to leave brief Steam Reviews and let others know to check them out, this is incredibly helpful for us small developers to get discovered by more players. :)

notes.title: V2
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
-Added a small timer on player to show how long time based power ups have remaining.
-Extended time slow power up slightly, as well as changed so enemies gradually (but quickly) resume normal speed instead of instantly.
-Added a second check when exiting the game to properly shutdown the Steam API which I had reports that it had been remaining open after playing resulting in SteamCloud getting messed up. (will need feedback on whether this resolves those issues)
-Optimized a variety of GFX and textures to improve performance on extremely low end machines.
-Resolved an issue where transition system would get stuck and confused, resulting in some loading not being hidden.
-Resolved correct link for new Developer page.
-Improved some translations with player feedback.

HOTFIX 07-02-2018
Resolved an exploitable bug with the special power ups. Thanks for the heads up :)

Thank you to everyone for playing and sharing the game with your friends and family I appreciate your support immensely. If you are enjoying my games, make sure to leave brief Steam Reviews and let others know to check it out, this is massively important for us small developers.

Adam Nickerson
